question: Pavri Naach, a tribal dance of Maharashtra and Gujarat region is performed by which of the following tribes?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kokna**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pavri Naach** is a traditional tribal dance performed by the **Kokna tribe**.
 
• This dance is predominantly performed in the **regions of Maharashtra and Gujarat**.
 
• The dance is usually performed during **harvest season** and other festive occasions.
 
• **Instruments** used in Pavri Naach include traditional drums and flutes, enhancing the rhythmic movements.
 
• The dance is characterized by its **energetic and joyful movements**, reflecting the **cultural heritage and traditional practices** of the Kokna tribe.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Khatola**__

 __
 
• The term **Khatola** does not refer to a specific tribe; it often refers to a type of traditional conveyance or swing in Indian culture.
 
 
 
• **Koli**__
 __
 
• The **Koli tribe** is predominantly found in the coastal regions of **Maharashtra**, known for their fishing community and unique dances such as the **Koli Dance**.
 
 
 
• **Kalanga**__
 
 
• The term **Kalanga** may refer to a particular community or tribe, but it is not associated with the Pavri Naach dance in the Maharashtra and Gujarat regions.
